verdict.rationale: The docs say cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated through the API for use in your own case-management system. Supporting pieces include webhooks with idempotency keys and a WORKFLOW_COMPLETED event, a case audit-trail endpoint, case exports, lookup by external identifier, and a published OpenAPI schema covering case and audit resources. Missing for 10: a documented webhook for case or decision state changes, an explicit decision-write endpoint showing how the three case decisions are set via API, and independent or hands-on proof of bidirectional sync.
